races.verdict: WHAT'S THE PLAN has taken his form up a level in defeat this season and James Fanshawe's 3-y-o looks ready to add to his tally. He gets the vote over Warning Sign , who landed back-to-back course wins here last summer (including this race) and arrives on the back of a career-best having bolted up at Goodwood 8 weeks ago. Drumstick looks best of the rest provided he's ready to roll after 3 months off. WHAT'S THE PLAN WARNING SIGN (FR) DRUMSTICK
